text:
Initially, I had Claude make this animation in 2D. It wrote the piano score and drew every frame in JavaScript.

I gave this 2D version as reference to another Claude. Because the whole film was code, Claude was able to use its exact choreography and make the 3D one in Blender. https://t.co/XAb8XZgQG3
